pairs: Praise the name of the Lord.
You who stand in the house of the Lord,
in the courts of the house of our God:
For the Lord has chosen Jacob for himself,
Quia ego cognovi quod magnus est Dominus,
For I have known that the Lord is great,
et Deus noster præ omnibus diis.
and our God is before all gods.
All things whatsoever that he willed, the Lord did:
in mari et in omnibus abyssis.
in the sea, and in all the deep places.
He leads clouds from the ends of the earth.
He has created lightnings in the rain.
qui producit ventos de thesauris suis.
He has produced winds from his storehouses.
He struck the first-born of Egypt,
Et misit signa et prodigia in medio tui,
He sent signs and wonders into your midst,
in Pharaonem, et in omnes servos ejus.
upon Pharaoh and upon all his servants.
and he has slaughtered strong kings:
and all the kingdoms of Canaan.
And he gave their land as an inheritance,
as an inheritance for his people Israel.
memoriale tuum in generationem et generationem.
Your memorial, O Lord, is from generation to generation.
For the Lord will judge his people,
and he will be petitioned by his servants.
The idols of the Gentiles are silver and gold,
the works of the hands of men.
neque enim est spiritus in ore ipsorum.
For neither is there any breath in their mouths.
Similes illis fiant qui faciunt ea,
Let those who make them become like them,
et omnes qui confidunt in eis.
along with all who trust in them.
The Lord is blessed from Zion,
by those who dwell in Jerusalem.
